description: The brief gives a link as a relative .md path: the link doc-page-updater adds is the site-root route of the target page (/portal/settings/settings), and the existing links are untouched.
setup:
mkdir -p portal/transactions/.sources && cat > portal/transactions/.sources/change-brief.md <<'EOF'
# Change brief — export link

## Page
portal/transactions/transactions.md

## What changed
- The transaction list can now be exported to CSV. The export format is set on the settings page. Add a sentence that links to it: `../settings/settings.md`. — source: ticket #34

## Where in the page
The section «Перегляд транзакцій», after «Список оновлюється автоматично.»

## Screenshots
- none

## Terms
- none

## Do not touch
- The sections «Фільтрування транзакцій» and «Повідомлення про платежі».
EOF
git add -A && git commit -q -m 'Case setup'
prompt: use doc-page-updater with page `portal/transactions/transactions.md` and brief `portal/transactions/.sources/change-brief.md`

assertions.name: new link is the root route
